kind: Native slide adaptation of the recorded benchmark setup

source_snapshot.kind: Hardware and software snapshot for the completed full benchmark presentation

evidence_scope.recorded_in_benchmark: GPU identity, Python, PyTorch, CUDA runtime, NumPy, settings, coverage and timing from saved run
evidence_scope.host_snapshot: CPU, memory, OS, kernel and GPU driver inspected after the run; driver version was not logged by the benchmark
evidence_scope.other_libraries: Shapely and Matplotlib from the unchanged experiment environment

source_snapshot.aggregation: One active agent at one frame is one vehicle view. Match within each view, then pool all views for AP. The same car seen by different agents contributes a separate reference in each view.
source_snapshot.timing_scope: Whole test split, both sharing conditions together; includes loading, inference, decoding/NMS, writing and AP. Excludes data download, initial checkpoint loading and figure export.

memory_display: Rounded whole-number GB, matching report page 7; exact quantities retained in the source snapshot
